title: Graphic texts: implied messages and design elements
canonical_examples_source: Language rules self-verified; format ref: bank uk-ks2-2024-gps (KS2 GPS).

blocks.content: Graphic texts also send messages they do not say out loud. These implied messages are carried by design — the colours, the size of things, and the images chosen.
An implied message is suggested through images, colour and design, not stated in words.

steps: A juice advert shows a big, smiling family in bright sunshine.
It never says 'this juice makes families happy'.
But the design implies exactly that.

blocks.question: An advert for trainers shows a famous runner winning a race. What is the implied message?
options: these trainers will help you win
blocks.explain: The design suggests, without saying it, that the trainers make you a winner — that is the implied message.
blocks.rule: An implied message is suggested through images, colour and design, not stated in words.

practiceItems.prompt: a message that is suggested, not stated, is ___ (implied/overt)
colour, size and images are ___ elements
bright colours and smiles suggest a ___ feeling (happy/sad)
an implied message is not said in ___

blocks.content: Design elements — big text, bold colours, and chosen images — are used to guide how you feel.

blocks.question: Why is the price on a sale poster often the biggest, brightest text?
options: to catch your eye and pull you in
blocks.explain: Big, bright text is a design choice made to grab your attention.
blocks.rule: Design elements like size and colour are chosen to catch attention and shape feelings.

practiceItems.prompt: the biggest word on a poster is meant to catch your ___
colour, size and images are ___ elements
bold red can suggest ___ or danger (excitement/boredom)

blocks.question: A gym poster shows a strong, smiling person mid-workout, with no words about how you will feel. What is the IMPLIED message?
options: That the gym will make you strong and happy — it is suggested by the image
That the person is tired and sad
There is no message at all
blocks.explain: An implied message is suggested rather than stated. The strong, smiling person hints that joining the gym will make YOU strong and happy, even though no words say so. You read the image, not just the words.
blocks.rule: An implied message is suggested by images or design, not stated in words.
blocks.principle: Design choices carry meaning beyond the written words.
canonical_solution: The image shows strength and a smile
That suggests you will be strong and happy
So that is the implied message

rubric.look_for: reads the image, not just words

misconceptions.coach: The person is strong and smiling — a positive suggestion.
Images imply messages even without words.

practiceItems.prompt: a message suggested but not stated is
the strong smiling person suggests you will be

blocks.content: Look past the words: colours, sizes and images whisper an implied message. Read the design, not just the text. Let's practise!
